snippet.title: Pokémon Emerald Rogue 2.0 Trailer (Game is out now!)
snippet.description:
It’s official Emerald Rogue 2.0 is here!
https://www.pokecommunity.com/threads/pokemon-emerald-rogue.479406/

2.0 is a (soft) sequel, which takes the core formula from the past versions and polishes just about every inch possible! With improved progression, deeper features and QoL improvements for pretty much anything/everything you could think of!

Emerald Rogue is a reimagining of Pokémon as a Roguelike which aims to provide convert the traditional formula into a new faster format

Join the Discord to keep up to date on Emerald Rogue:
https://rogue.discord.pokabbie.com/
